info.title: CliDoc
info.description: Generate beautiful static documentation websites for System.CommandLine CLI tools

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Generate beautiful static documentation for System.CommandLine CLI tools

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

commands.name: init
commands.description: Generate a cli-docs.yaml scaffold from a commands.json file.

options.name: --commands-json
options.description: Path to commands.json. Defaults to ./commands.json if it exists.

options.name: --output
options.description: Output file path. [default: cli-docs.yaml]

options.name: --root-name
options.description: Override the root command's name used as the YAML map key.

commands.name: generate
commands.description: Generate commands.json or a documentation site.

commands.name: commands
commands.description: Extract commands.json from a System.CommandLine assembly or project.

options.name: --assembly
options.description: Path to the compiled CLI assembly (.dll) to reflect over.

options.name: --project
options.description: Path to a .csproj file; clidoc will build it and reflect over the output.

options.name: --entry-type
options.description: Fully-qualified type name with a static method returning RootCommand.

options.name: --root-name
options.description: Override the root command's name in the emitted JSON. Defaults to the csproj's <ToolCommandName> (via --project).

options.name: --output
options.description: Output path for the generated commands.json. [default: commands.json]

options.name: --pretty
options.description: Pretty-print the JSON (default: true). [default: True]

commands.name: docs
commands.description: Render a static documentation site from commands.json.

options.name: --commands-json
options.description: Path to commands.json. Defaults to ./commands.json if it exists.

options.name: --metadata
options.description: Path to cli-docs.yaml metadata file. Defaults to ./cli-docs.yaml if it exists.

options.name: --output
options.description: Output directory for generated site. [default: ./clidoc-output]

options.name: --title
options.description: Site title (overrides metadata).

options.name: --root-name
options.description: Override the root command's name (affects breadcrumbs, tree root, and subcommand full names).

options.name: --base-url
options.description: Base URL for canonical links.

options.name: --no-llms-txt
options.description: Skip llms.txt generation. [default: False]

options.name: --no-commands-json
options.description: Don't copy commands.json into the output directory (and hide its nav link). [default: False]

commands.name: commands
commands.description: Export the CLI command tree as commands.json (for clidoc).

options.name: --output
options.description: Output file path. If omitted, JSON is written to standard output.

options.name: --pretty
options.description: Pretty-print JSON (default: true). [default: True]

options.name: --name
options.description: Override the root command's name in the emitted JSON.
